title: WotbMod Lua mod manifest (mods/lua/<id>/manifest.json)
description: The manifest of an installed Lua mod. The host reads exactly id, entrypoint and permissions; name, version, developer and description are metadata for people and catalogs and are ignored by the host.

id.description: Stable mod id with an author prefix, such as author.mod_name. The folder under mods/lua must have the same name.

entrypoint.description: The single Lua file the host runs, in the mod folder root. Default main.lua.

permissions.description: Permission names the mod asks for. The host grants the intersection with its own ceiling; an unknown name grants nothing.

version.description: Semantic version; read by catalogs and the launcher, not by the host.
